text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos achieved a brilliant result in the 
Nakayama Kinen. However, thoroughly 
exhausted, she slumped to the ground, 
unable to move.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer suggests postponing the Dubai 
race just to be safe. Moved by their 
concern, Vivlos agrees.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead, Vivlos sets her sights on the 
Victoria Mile, a race won back-to-back by 
her older sister, Verxina. A new domestic 
challenge had begun.
